Vocal: Piya Sang Khelun Hori
A soulful Hindustani classical vocal rendition by Ustad Ghulam Mustafa Khan, featuring “Piya Sang Khelun Hori” . The performance highlights the melodic character of the raga and the artist’s expressive voice and mastery of Hindustani classical music.
